scientific_integrity: An exact scalar invariant reduction and analytical calibration inequality underpin the finding; finite calculations corroborate only. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite, deterministic, homogeneous, row-stochastic social networks; a single uniform finite-duration nonnegative broadcast from the all-zero initial condition; idealized clipped-quadratic response. Not heterogeneous, locally targeted, stochastic, or bounded-amplitude optimal control. Strict success requires dose greater than the sharp infimum. Priority risk from broader existing minimum-fuel control theory remains.
title: Sharp broadcast-dose frontier for saturated network opinion cascades
